title: WinX Club - Quest for the Codex (USA)

fields.name: checksum_lo
fields.description: Low half of 64-bit complemented carry-sum integrity checksum over save bytes 8..511.
fields.evidence: FUN_080059c4 accumulates u32 words of buffer DAT_08005a34 from word index 2 with carry and stores ~sum at save offsets 0..3; FUN_08005b44 re-sums save offsets 0..511 seeded from DAT_08005bb0 and treats the image valid only if the 64-bit total is 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF.

fields.name: checksum_hi
fields.description: High half of 64-bit complemented carry-sum integrity checksum over save bytes 8..511.
fields.evidence: FUN_080059c4 stores the complemented high carry word at save offsets 4..7 (buffer DAT_08005a34 word index 1); FUN_08005b44 validates it as the high half of the 64-bit total over save offsets 0..511.

fields.name: save_magic
fields.description: Save-format magic: must equal the expected constant or the game re-initializes the save.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005b44 compares the u16 at buffer DAT_08005ba8 word index 2 (save offset 8) against *DAT_08005bac and re-inits otherwise; FUN_08005b44 and FUN_08005c04 stamp the expected constant at save offset 8 on init.

fields.name: progress_flags
fields.description: Tail config byte ahead of the stage selector; cleared to 0 by save init.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005b44 zeroes the tail u32 covering save offsets 252..255 (buffer DAT_08005ba8 word index 63) and FUN_08005c04 stores 0 at save offset 252 (buffer DAT_08005c2c + 0xfc).

fields.name: current_stage
fields.description: Current stage/world selector (6-way dispatch); set via the stage setter, read back on boot and map load.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005f50 returns save offset 253 (buffer DAT_08005f58 + 0xfd); FUN_08005fdc writes it; FUN_08005c34, FUN_08005d00, FUN_08006008, FUN_08006068, FUN_080060c8, FUN_08006128, FUN_08006188 and FUN_08002ef3c each dispatch on this byte with a < 6 range check.

fields.name: stage_valid_flag
fields.description: Stage-commit marker: set to 1 whenever the stage selector is written and persisted.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005fdc stores 1 at save offset 254 (buffer DAT_08005ff4 + 0xfe) immediately after writing the stage byte and calls FUN_08005be0 to persist; cleared to 0 by save init in FUN_08005b44 and FUN_08005c04.
